intake.business_request_raw: Modernize the kotlin-spring-vue Spring Boot + Vue codebase to a Go (chi) target stack with REST contracts and parity-preserving migration.
assumptions: The existing database schema will remain unchanged.
The frontend will continue to interact with the backend via REST APIs.

must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the Go application adheres to security standards and practices.
must.metric: Pass all security audits and penetration tests
acceptance_criteria: Security audits reveal no critical vulnerabilities.
Penetration tests confirm robust security posture.
Compliance checks validate adherence to security standards.

must.title: Reliability and Uptime
must.description: Ensure the Go application maintains high reliability and uptime.
acceptance_criteria: Monitoring tools confirm uptime metrics are met.
Incident reports show no significant downtime.

should.title: Performance Benchmarking
should.description: Ensure the Go application meets or exceeds the performance benchmarks of the legacy system.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests
acceptance_criteria: Load tests confirm response times meet benchmarks.
Performance tests show no degradation compared to legacy.
Scalability tests validate application under peak load.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Portability and Deployment
should.description: Ensure the Go application can be deployed across different environments with minimal changes.
should.metric: Deployment scripts work across all target environments
acceptance_criteria: Deployment tests confirm application runs in all environments.
Portability tests validate minimal configuration changes.

should.title: Usability and Documentation
should.description: Ensure the Go application is user-friendly and well-documented.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 8/10 or higher
acceptance_criteria: Documentation is complete and easy to understand.
